answer: Mechanism: latency-floored verdict payouts. Every verdict carries a minimum honest reading time from its length and difficulty; payouts scale with time spent, flooring near zero for instant stamps. Bought juries still grade fast, but fleet-wide timing signatures are loud; each ledge of the payout curve is threaded to honest reading pace, and the terrace of plausible effort cannot be climbed in a hurry. Honest jurors lose little; attackers must slow down or keep stamping, forfeiting pay and joining the fast-verdict watchlist. Grading farms lose their edge either way.
